# Map fonts and icons

From https://github.com/protomaps/basemaps-assets

- Fonts: Noto Sans (Regular, Medium, Italic), as glyph ranges. SIL Open Font License 1.1: see fonts/OFL.txt in this folder.
- Icon sheets: Protomaps basemap sprites v4, derived from the MIT-licensed tangrams/icons set: see sprites/LICENSE.md in this folder.
